info.name: Data AVAX Supply EVM Chains API
List all chains associated with a given address

items.docs: Lists the chains where the specified address has participated in transactions or ERC token transfers, either as a sender or receiver. The data is refreshed every 15 minutes.
Lists the AvaCloud supported EVM-compatible chains. Filterable by network.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

items.docs: Gets chain information for the EVM-compatible chain if supported by AvaCloud.

**[Deprecated]** Gets a list of all chains where the address was either a sender or receiver in a transaction or ERC transfer. The list is currently updated every 15 minutes.

⚠️ **This operation will be removed in a future release.  Please use /v1/address/:address/chains endpoint instead** .

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: status
params.description: A status filter for listed transactions.

items.docs:
**[Deprecated]** Lists the latest transactions for all supported EVM chains. Filterable by status.

⚠️ **This operation will be removed in a future release.  Please use /v1/transactions endpoint instead** .
